				<h4>WHERE DO I GET BACKLINKS?</h4>
<p>Backlinks can be found in many places across the internet.  These opportunities come in many forms such as the likes of social media sites, guest blogging opportunities, directories, blog comments.  Generally, to increase the power of your links for Google on your Denver web design website it is wise to create links that can enrich the experience of a user to your site with original content.  These can be created by meaningful responses to comments, replies or original posts in forums, or a blog created on another site for anything pertaining to your industry.  It is best to be informative and educational.</p>

<p>SEO is search engine optimization and it is the process of ranking on any search engine. You may have a beautiful Denver website design but if your target audience can’t find you online then it really isn’t serving its purpose.</p>

# Tag Team Design: Denver Web Design | AI Search Optimization | SEO Consulting

> Tag Team Design is a Denver web design and AI search optimization agency with 16 years of experience helping Colorado businesses build, rank, and stay visible in the era of AI-driven search. Founded in 2010, we specialize in web design, SEO consulting, generative engine optimization (GEO), digital marketing, eCommerce development, and mobile app design. We help small and medium-sized businesses in Denver and across Colorado compete in a search landscape transformed by AI Overviews, zero-click searches, and LLM-driven discovery.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.tagteamdesign.com/)
- [What We Do](https://www.tagteamdesign.com/what-we-do/)
- [Our Work](https://www.tagteamdesign.com/our-work/)
- [Who We Are](https://www.tagteamdesign.com/about-us/)
- [Our Process](https://www.tagteamdesign.com/our-process/)
- [Contact](https://www.tagteamdesign.com/contact/)

## Services
- [Denver Web Design](https://www.tagteamdesign.com/our-services/denver-web-design/): Custom responsive website design for Denver businesses. Built for performance, conversions, and search visibility.
- [Search Engine Optimization](https://www.tagteamdesign.com/our-services/search-engine-optimization/): Denver SEO consulting with 16 years of proven results. Keyword research, on-site optimization, link building, and local SEO for Colorado businesses.
- [Web Development](https://www.tagteamdesign.com/our-services/web-development/): Full-stack web development including WordPress, custom builds, and performance optimization.
